name: פירוק פולינום ממעלה שלישית לגורמים לינאריים – כששורש אחד ידוע (באנגלית)
questiontext:
Factorise the expression

\[ {{CT:0}} \]

into the form

\[ \left(x - a\right)\left(x - b\right) \left(x - c\right) \]

given that the expression evaluates to zero when \(x = {{CT:1}}\). The roots are real.

[[validation:ans1]]
generalfeedback:
Outline: A known root of the polynomial gives a linear factor. Write the cubic as this factor times a quadratic with two unknown roots, match the coefficients, and solve for the two roots.
Step 1 — A known factor
Given that the polynomial {{CT:2}} is zero when \(x = {{CT:1}}\), then one of the factors is \(\left({{CT:3}}\right)\), which is of course zero when \(x = {{CT:1}}\). The polynomial factorises as

\[ \begin{array}{rcl}\displaystyle {{CT:0}}&\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:4}}\mbox{,}\\ &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:5}}\mbox{,}\\ &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:6}}\mbox{,}\\ &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:7}}. \end{array} \]

Step 2 — Matching coefficients
Matching coefficients

\[ \begin{array}{rcl}\displaystyle {{CT:1}} + m + n&\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:8}}\mbox{,}\\ {{CT:9}}+ {{CT:10}} + {{CT:11}}&\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:12}}\mbox{,}\\ {{CT:13}}&\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:14}}. \end{array} \]

So

\[ m = {{CT:15}} - n\mbox{,} \]

and

\[ {{CT:11}} = {{CT:16}}\mbox{.} \]

Step 3 — Solving for \(m\) and \(n\)
Substituting for \(m\) in terms of \(n\)

\[ \displaystyle {{CT:17}}\displaystyle =\displaystyle {{CT:16}}\mbox{.} \]

This can be rearranged as

\[ {{CT:18}}\displaystyle =\displaystyle 0\mbox{.} \]

Factorising

\[ {{CT:19}} = 0\mbox{,} \]

and either \(n = {{CT:20}}\) and so \(m = {{CT:21}}\) or \(n = {{CT:21}}\) and \(m = {{CT:20}}\).
Step 4 — The factorisation
The polynomial {{CT:2}} factorises as

\[ {{CT:22}}\mbox{.} \]
